ctx.x: I had agreed to a new contract with the Chikito starting the 1st of December, 1950, so we decided to go to Paris to engage some musicians. We left Viareggio the 6th of October and arrived in Paris the next day. It was quite a thrill for Lily because she had never been to Paris and it was a pleasure for me to show her around this wonderful city. Paris has so many places to go and things to see, which is always amazing and I got as much kicks out of showing Lily what I knew of Paris as much as she got learning…

A few days after we arrived I was contacted to make a five days tour with a small variety show called Radio Cocktail 51. The three Peter Sisters who were a very popular singing trio in the States were in France and there were two younger sisters named Edith and Joyce who had formed a singing duo and they were part of the show which included André Salvador, the brother of Henri who was very famous singer and comedian in Europe. I first met the Salvador brothers in late 1935 at the Villa d'Este when they were about…

The two sisters were billed as the Peter Sisters Jr. and their mother travelled with us. Our first date was in Perpignan at the Nouveau theatre the 23rd of October. Then came Toulouse, Castre, Montpellier, Beziers, which was the last date. In Montpellier, Joyce and Edith ran into some racial trouble which I have never experienced in France. They had been booked in a different hotel from the one we were in and when they arrived and asked for their reservations, they were told that none had been made for them. Miss…
